#
# Cyphal stack of UNIMOC: libcanard 4.x with O1Heap, the C serialization of
# the DSDL types generated by Nunavut, and the portable node layer of this
# directory. libcanard, O1Heap and the public regulated data types are west
# projects (west.yml); the paths can be overridden for other workspaces.

get_filename_component(UNIMOC_WEST_TOPDIR "${ZEPHYR_BASE}/.." ABSOLUTE)
set(UNIMOC_LIBCANARD_DIR "${UNIMOC_WEST_TOPDIR}/modules/lib/libcanard"
    CACHE PATH "libcanard checkout (west.yml)")
set(UNIMOC_O1HEAP_DIR "${UNIMOC_WEST_TOPDIR}/modules/lib/o1heap"
    CACHE PATH "O1Heap checkout (west.yml)")
set(UNIMOC_PUBLIC_DSDL_DIR "${UNIMOC_WEST_TOPDIR}/modules/lib/public_regulated_data_types"
    CACHE PATH "OpenCyphal public regulated data types (west.yml)")
get_filename_component(UNIMOC_VENDOR_DSDL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../dsdl/unimoc" ABSOLUTE)
# Root namespace cymon of the trace services (lib/cymon, submodule).
get_filename_component(UNIMOC_CYMON_DSDL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../cymon/dsdl/cymon" ABSOLUTE)

foreach(unimoc_dependency libcanard/canard.h o1heap/o1heap.h)
  string(REGEX MATCH "^[a-z0-9]+" unimoc_dependency_name "${unimoc_dependency}")
  string(TOUPPER "${unimoc_dependency_name}" unimoc_dependency_var)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${UNIMOC_${unimoc_dependency_var}_DIR}/${unimoc_dependency}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${unimoc_dependency_name} not found in ${UNIMOC_${unimoc_dependency_var}_DIR}: "
                        "run 'west update' in the workspace.")
  endif()
endforeach()

# --- DSDL serialization (Nunavut, C) ----------------------------------------
# Generated at configure time into the build directory. The generation runs
# again when a vendor or cymon type changes (CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS) or the output is
# missing; nunavut is a Python requirement of the workspace
# (scripts/requirements-cyphal.txt).
set(UNIMOC_DSDL_OUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/dsdl")
file(GLOB_RECURSE unimoc_vendor_dsdl CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
     "${UNIMOC_VENDOR_DSDL_DIR}/*.dsdl"
     "${UNIMOC_CYMON_DSDL_DIR}/*.dsdl")
# A changed vendor type reruns the configuration and with it the generation.
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${unimoc_vendor_dsdl})
set(unimoc_dsdl_stamp "${UNIMOC_DSDL_OUT}/.stamp")
set(unimoc_dsdl_regenerate FALSE)
if(NOT EXISTS "${unimoc_dsdl_stamp}")
  set(unimoc_dsdl_regenerate TRUE)
else()
  foreach(unimoc_dsdl_file IN LISTS unimoc_vendor_dsdl)
    if("${unimoc_dsdl_file}" IS_NEWER_THAN "${unimoc_dsdl_stamp}")
      set(unimoc_dsdl_regenerate TRUE)
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()

if(unimoc_dsdl_regenerate)
  if(NOT PYTHON_EXECUTABLE)
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    set(PYTHON_EXECUTABLE ${Python3_EXECUTABLE})
  endif()
  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${UNIMOC_DSDL_OUT}")
  set(unimoc_nnvg ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} -m nunavut -O ${UNIMOC_DSDL_OUT} -l c --target-endianness little)
  set(unimoc_dsdl_roots
      "${UNIMOC_PUBLIC_DSDL_DIR}/uavcan"
      "${UNIMOC_PUBLIC_DSDL_DIR}/reg"
      "${UNIMOC_VENDOR_DSDL_DIR}"
      "${UNIMOC_CYMON_DSDL_DIR}")
  set(unimoc_dsdl_lookup)
  foreach(unimoc_dsdl_root IN LISTS unimoc_dsdl_roots)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${unimoc_nnvg} ${unimoc_dsdl_lookup} ${unimoc_dsdl_root}
                    RESULT_VARIABLE unimoc_nnvg_result
                    OUTPUT_QUIET
                    ERROR_VARIABLE unimoc_nnvg_error)
    if(NOT unimoc_nnvg_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Nunavut failed on ${unimoc_dsdl_root} (${unimoc_nnvg_result}):\n${unimoc_nnvg_error}\n"
                          "Install it with: pip install -r <unimoc>/scripts/requirements-cyphal.txt")
    endif()
    list(APPEND unimoc_dsdl_lookup -I ${unimoc_dsdl_root})
  endforeach()
  file(TOUCH "${unimoc_dsdl_stamp}")
endif()

# --- libcanard and O1Heap (C, upstream code: Zephyr flags only) -------------
add_library(unimoc_canard STATIC
  ${UNIMOC_LIBCANARD_DIR}/libcanard/canard.c
  ${UNIMOC_O1HEAP_DIR}/o1heap/o1heap.c)
target_include_directories(unimoc_canard SYSTEM PUBLIC
  ${UNIMOC_LIBCANARD_DIR}/libcanard
  ${UNIMOC_LIBCANARD_DIR}/lib/cavl2
  ${UNIMOC_O1HEAP_DIR}/o1heap)
target_link_libraries(unimoc_canard PRIVATE zephyr_interface)

# --- Portable node layer (strict warnings) ----------------------------------
add_library(unimoc_cyphal STATIC
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/canard_transport.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/node.cpp
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/register_value.cpp)

target_include_directories(unimoc_cyphal PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..)
# Generated code is not held to the UNIMOC warning set.
target_include_directories(unimoc_cyphal SYSTEM PUBLIC ${UNIMOC_DSDL_OUT})

target_link_libraries(unimoc_cyphal PUBLIC project_options project_warnings unimoc_canard)
# isfinite() for the generated headers in C++ (nunavut_compat.hpp).
target_compile_options(unimoc_cyphal PUBLIC
  "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:SHELL:-include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/nunavut_compat.hpp>")
target_link_libraries(unimoc_cyphal PRIVATE zephyr_interface unimoc_strict_warnings)

add_library(unimoc::cyphal ALIAS unimoc_cyphal)
